usage: main.py [-h] {doctor,run} ...

BUILDv1-B10: source-build an OpenJDK 21 server image and consume it. Root-
cause fixes carried forward: * Upstream configure hard-fails on
JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS/_JAVA_OPTIONS, so both are explicitly removed from every
child environment via `/usr/bin/env -u JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS -u _JAVA_OPTIONS
<argv>`. Thread bounding is done only through upstream-supported knobs. * The
previous 4096-PID cgroup exhaustion happened because jdk21u enables javac-
server by default (make/autoconf/build-performance.m4 exposes --disable-javac-
server) and each module then spawns its own javac daemon plus worker threads.
We now pass --disable-javac-server, --with-jobs=1, --with-num-cores=1, make
JOBS=1, JTREG JOBS=1 and bounded JVM options. Every build/test/consumer
command runs via buildkit.Session so argument lists, exit codes and full logs
are preserved.

positional arguments:
  {doctor,run}

options:
  -h, --help    show this help message and exit
